Distinction: Sophisticated and flawless execution; code is clean, reproducible, and well-documented; advanced use of tools.
Commendation: Strong execution with minor issues; reproducible and well-structured code.
Pass: Adequate execution; some reproducibility or code clarity issues.
Marginal Fail: Limited execution; reproducibility or code structure is weak.
Fail: Poor execution; code is unclear, incomplete, or non-functional.

Distinction: Visualisations are highly effective, insightful, and adhere to best practices; excellent design choices.
Commendation: Mostly effective and well-designed; some minor design flaws.
Pass: Generally clear; some visualisations lack clarity or design coherence.
Marginal Fail: Visualisations are inconsistent or poorly designed.
Fail: Visualisations are ineffective, misleading, or missing.

Distinction: Excellent choice of behavioural dataset; complex and rich in insight; well-justified.
Commendation: Good choice; relevant and moderately complex.
Pass: Acceptable choice; some relevance or complexity issues.
Marginal Fail: Weak choice; limited relevance or insight.

Distinction: Dashboard is highly interactive, intuitive, and enables deep exploration of behavioural data.
Commendation: Dashboard is functional and user-friendly; supports exploration.
Pass: Dashboard works but lacks depth or polish.
Marginal Fail: Dashboard is limited or difficult to use.

Distinction: Insightful reflection; demonstrates creativity, independence, and deep understanding of constraints.
Commendation: Thoughtful reflection; shows good awareness and some creativity.

Distinction: Exceptionally clear and well-structured; professional presentation.
Commendation: Clear and coherent; minor issues in structure or writing.
Pass: Adequate clarity; some structural or writing issues.
